criterion: Permission failure: unexplained placeholders and raw error
description: D-2 confirmed for PHARMACIST. The wildcard grant inventory:item:* never matches. On Today, Low stock and Expiring show '—' with no reason, and the Low stock row is not clickable. 'Check low stock' opens the Stock list with the raw banner 'This action requires inventory:item:read (Reference: …) Retry', then 'Stock results unavailable' and an empty table. Retry can never succeed.
expected: The pharmacist can read stock. If access really is missing, show a plain-language message ('Your role can't view stock. Ask an admin.') with no Retry.
actual: Raw permission key, a Retry that cannot help, and silent dashes.
suggested_fix: Expand wildcard grants in the permission checks (PermissionsGuard plus the inventory Set.has checks). Map 403 errors to a permission empty state.

criterion: Text fit: action buttons wrap one letter per line
description: In the Stock list at 1280x800, the row actions 'Edit price' and 'Edit stock' are squeezed into a narrow last column and render one letter per line. Each row grows to about 220px, so the list shows about 2 batches per screen. 'Filters', 'Reset' and the product-name buttons are also reported as wrapped.
expected: Row actions stay on one line (an icon menu, or a whitespace-nowrap column), and rows are about 60px tall.
actual: Vertical button labels and very tall rows.
suggested_fix: Give the Edit column a min width with whitespace-nowrap, or collapse the actions into a '⋯' menu. The Button base class's [overflow-wrap:anywhere] makes this worse.

description: Story claim confirmed. The header notification links /dashboard/inventory?tab=low-stock and ?tab=expiry land on Today with no filter. During this session the bell also listed no low-stock item at all (only '7 upcoming appointments'), although Today showed 4–6 low-stock batches.
expected: The bell links use ?area=stock&view=list&stock=LOW and &expiryMonths=3, and the bell reflects current low-stock counts.
actual: Old ?tab= links, and no low-stock notification.
suggested_fix: Update the hrefs in header.tsx (lines ~207, 214, 269, 277), or map legacy ?tab= values in InventoryWorkspace.

criterion: Scroll necessity: results below the fold
description: After 'Low stock' is clicked, the first 800px are taken up by sub-tasks, title, search, three batch-view pills, the Stock level/Expiry selects, the active-filter chip, Sort and a value summary table. The matching batches start below the fold, so the 2-click ideal path still needs a scroll before anything can be read.
expected: Collapse the filters into the 'Filters' button when arriving from a queue link, and show the results first.

description: Story claim confirmed. The approvals row shows the count twice: '0' in the count column and '(0)' in the label 'Price/stock edits awaiting approval (0)'.
suggested_fix: Drop the '(N)' suffix from the label.

criterion: Labels: raw parameter names and enums
description: The active-filter chips show raw query keys ('stock: LOW ×', 'expiryMonths: 3 ×'). The units are uppercase enums ('5 PACKS', '2 PIECES', '60 STRIPS'). Every low-stock row reads 'Batch missing / On hand, expiry unverified', and the list mixes devices (Dermatoscope, Cryo Spray) with medicines without telling them apart.
expected: Chips such as 'Low stock ×' and 'Expiring within 3 months ×', lowercase units, and a way to tell consumables and devices apart.

description: Opening 'SHORTBOOK-2026-11-07' from Recent activity gives ?area=reorder&view=SHORTBOOK&document=… with no return= parameter, which contradicts the story's claim that return= is preserved. The user gets back to Today only through the area tab.
expected: return=today is preserved, and the editor's back control goes to Today.
actual: There is no return context in the URL.
